description: Starts an SEO and AI-visibility audit on a URL without waiting. Returns the id and status. Use get_audit_status to follow progress and get_audit for the results. An audit of one of your sites appears in its history, and each site can be audited once per day.

siteId.description: Attach the audit to one of your sites (optional). When omitted, the audit is attached to your site with the same URL, if there is one.

name: run_audit
title: Start an audit (non-blocking)
